description: Deploy a service to Compute Portal from a Docker image or a public GitHub repo. When given a GitHub repo URL, CP clones it and builds the image internally from the Dockerfile — no registry needed. Returns a Service on success, or an X402Challenge if require_x402 is set and payment is required — sign the challenge with wallet_sign_x402 and retry this tool with x_payment set. For cost preview call with dry_run: true first.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token returned by a prior dry_run call. Required for destructive tools.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs and return a planned action + confirm_token without mutating state. Call again with the returned confirm_token to execute.

gpu.description: GPU type: rtx5090 | gb10. Shorthand for machine_type when you want a GPU SKU.

image.description: Docker image to deploy (e.g. myorg/agent:latest). Provide either image or repo.

machine_type.description: Compute SKU id as listed by cp_catalog_list (e.g. cpu-small, cpu-med, test-smoke, gb10, gpu-rtx5090). Takes precedence over `gpu` when both are set. Omit both to default to cpu-small.

name.description: Service name (default: derived from image or repo)

repo.description: Public GitHub repo URL to build and deploy (e.g. https://github.com/org/repo). CP clones the repo and builds the image from the Dockerfile internally. Provide either repo or image.

require_x402.description: Trigger the x402 pay-first handshake: cp-api returns 402 with pricing + authorization requirements; the caller signs an EIP-3009 USDC authorization and retries with X-Payment. When false/omitted, deploy proceeds under the caller's Bearer auth with no on-chain settlement.

x_payment.description: Base64url-encoded X-Payment header value from a prior wallet_sign_x402 call. Set on the retry after an X402Challenge response to complete the handshake.

name: cp_deploy
